approval.source: User feedback on 2026-08-12: 'cái màu xanh đâu phải border, nó là verdict mà nhỉ??? chốt thì dứt luôn apply'
retainedTraits: Legacy section-heading/action placement and one outer competition surface
Standing hero followed by one nested separated ranked list
Avatar, identity, XP and follow action row anatomy
Iconify Fluent Emoji medals for ranks 1/2/3 and trophy for every rank 4+

sharedDecisions: Section label and View leaderboard action remain outside the outer card.
Standing and nested ranked list share one outer competition surface.
RankMark owns a closed Iconify map: 1/2/3 place medals, 4+ trophy.
A row verdict is data-driven by rankDelta: positive is success, negative is danger, zero/null has no band.
Verdict renders as a two-pixel left inset band that follows row corner radius; it is never a border.
The viewer row is labelled You/Bạn and never receives a follow action.

vocabularyProposals.semanticMeaning: Closed rank artwork from @iconify/react Fluent Emoji Flat.

vocabularyProposals.absenceDefault: Ranks 1/2/3 map to their place medal; every rank 4+ maps to trophy.

vocabularyProposals.semanticMeaning: Optional movement verdict on one ranked user.
vocabularyProposals.propsDelta: verdict?: success | danger; avatar source; numeric rank
vocabularyProposals.placement: Two-pixel left inset band on the row contract selected by data.
vocabularyProposals.absenceDefault: No verdict for zero or absent rankDelta.

vocabularyProposals.compatibility: Additive data with absent default preserving old callers.
